english.note: Use this when an action or event happens in time to be useful or at the needed moment, rather than merely according to a schedule.
Use this when something happens just in time and successfully prevents it from being too late.

examples.english: I arrived in time to call an ambulance for him; my arrival was timely.
examples.traditional: 我及時趕到，幫佢叫咗白車。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 kap6 si4 gon2 dou3 bong1 keoi5 giu3 zo2 baak6 ce1

examples.english: You paid in time and avoided a last-minute cancellation.
examples.traditional: 你及時過數，先至冇畀人取消張單。
examples.jyutping: nei5 kap6 si4 gwo3 sou3 sin1 zi3 mou5 bei2 jan4 ceoi2 siu1 zoeng1 daan1
